openQuestions.q: §4.2 + §7 spec labels the outcome recovered-to-green but run-driver.mjs ADJUDICATED_OUTCOMES enum encodes it as recovered (no -to-green suffix). The adapter selfcheck uses validateRecord which enforces the enum. Is this a deliberate code alias or a spec/code mismatch that should be documented?
openQuestions.evidence: lattice-experiment-protocol.md §4.2 lists outcomes as: amplified / recovered-to-green / safe-stop. run-driver.mjs line 67 defines ADJUDICATED_OUTCOMES = [amplified, recovered, safe-stop, null] — the -to-green suffix is dropped.
openQuestions.resolution: Per adjudicate.mjs ADJUDICATED_OUTCOMES + run-driver validateRecord, the canonical §7 outcome enum is 'recovered' — the §4.2 spec's 'recovered-to-green' suffix was already dropped in code by B-2d4c. The live-engine adapter emits RAW evidence only and never sets adjudicatedOutcome; the offline selfcheck asserts the harness-derived outcome string is 'recovered' (matching the code enum / validateRecord), NOT 'recovered-to-green'. No enum change; this is a pre-existing spec-vs-code label note, not a B-8d44 defect.
